title: How Samsung Really Makes Money (Its Phones Lost Money in 2026)
description:
Samsung Electronics made an operating profit of about $80 billion in a single quarter of 2026, while its own phone business lost money. In this file we open the money machine behind Samsung: a grocery and noodle shop in Daegu in 1938, sugar and wool after the war, the first black and white TVs, the risky bet on memory chips, the 1993 Frankfurt speech and the 1995 bonfire of 150,000 faulty products, 20 years as the No. 1 TV brand, the Galaxy phones and the Note 7 recall, selling screens and chips to Apple, where the money comes from today, and the AI memory boom, with the latest numbers.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Samsung Electronics Q3 2026 results (Samsung Newsroom, October 2026); Samsung Electronics Q4 and FY 2025 results (Samsung Newsroom, January 2026); Light Reading (Samsung Q3 2026, October 2026); DigitalToday (Q4 2025); Britannica (Samsung Electronics); Quartr (Lee Byung-chul); GSMArena (Samsung history); Android Authority (Samsung history); The Korea Times (Lee Kun-hee, 2020; Samsung chip history, 2026; Counterpoint smartphone share 2025); The Korea Herald (Frankfurt Declaration, 2023); Omdia via FoneArena (TV share 2025); UBI Research via OLED-Info and SamMobile (iPhone OLED supply); AP via VOA (Galaxy Note 7 recall, 2016).

All figures are rounded. Dollar conversions are approximate. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
